name: starting-out-first-timer
why: VISION: someone beginning exercise for the first time is told, once, plainly and without alarm, to check with a doctor — and the app does not screen anyone. Both halves are gradeable: the sentence must be there, and a health questionnaire must not be.

contextOverrides.exercise_summary: Today (Tuesday): Walk 20 minutes at an easy pace.
